summary: PyAI for Startups puts a $10M pool behind 200+ voice-product startups. Three tiers: Launch $20,000 (400k Omni + 25k phone minutes), Growth $50,000 (1M Omni + 50k phone minutes), Scale $100,000 (2M Omni + 100k phone minutes). Credits cover AI meters on the PyAI rate card and release in 12 monthly parts over a one-year term; unused credit rolls forward within the term but expires 12 months after activation. Credits are non-transferable, non-refundable, tied to one organization, and have no cash value. Phone minutes beyond the included allowance cost $0.01/min and are not covered; phone numbers, SMS, carrier pass-through fees, taxes, anything outside the rate card, and enterprise add-ons (SSO, BAA, dedicated capacity) are also excluded. Eligibility: building a voice product live or launching within six months, working website, under $10M raised, incorporated fewer than seven years ago, not a current PyAI customer on an annual contract. No card required.
claim_steps: Apply at pyai.com/startups with company, product, stage, funding, and a demo link, two-minute video, or deck.
A person reviews within five business days (two via partner VC/accelerator).
On acceptance, sign up or sign in with the same email — credits attach automatically; no card needed.

Credits release in 12 monthly parts; unused credit rolls forward only within the term and expires 12 months after activation. The award is non-transferable, non-refundable, tied to one organization, and has no cash value.

Budget separately for phone minutes beyond your allowance ($0.01/min), phone numbers, SMS, carrier pass-through fees, taxes, anything outside the PyAI rate card, and enterprise add-ons (SSO, BAA, dedicated capacity); the award does not cover them.
